_comment: Golden/regression cases for scripts/extract_lifedates.py, per docs/pipeline-strategy.md strategy #8 (sibling of golden_entries.json and golden_xrefs.json). Cases identify their entry by (volume, headword_clean), never by id, for the same reason as golden_xrefs.json. `expect` is either the four date fields or null, meaning the pass must leave the entry undated. Every case was verified against the printed head of the entry as extracted into structured-data/lexikon.db. Run scripts/check_golden_lifedates.py after any change to extract_lifedates.py.

cases.name: the plain formula: 'Marburg a. d. Lahn 11. Febr. 1900, †Heidelberg 13. März 2002' -- day numbers before the month are not years, and 'a. d.' is not a sentence end
BC on both sides with the one-year slash form: 'Athen (oder Ägina) 428/427 v. Chr., †Athen 348/347 v. Chr.' -> 428, 348
'ca.' before both years is harmless: 'Milet ca. 625 v. Chr., †ca. 547 v. Chr.'
the marker printed once, on the death, entails a BC birth: 'Milet um 560, †ebendort um 480 v. Chr.'
a BC birth with an unmarked death is read as BC only because 212 AD would be a 499-year life: 'Syrakus 287 v. Chr., †ebd. 212'
a life spanning the era boundary is NOT forced to BC: 'um 75 v. Chr., † um 18 n. Chr.' -- 'n. Chr.' lets a two-digit number be a year
no era marker at all is not read: '384 in Stagira ... †322' -- the automatic pass refuses it and MANUAL_LIFEDATES restates the editors' reading
a one-year 'oder' alternative is accepted like the slash form: '1265 oder 1266, †Köln 8. Nov. 1308'
a long place of death does not lose the year: '†Neumark, Siebenbürgen (= Maros-Vásárhely, heute rumän. Tıˆrgu-Mures¸) 27. Jan. 1860'
a year before a full stop is a year, not a day ordinal: '†Göttingen 9. Okt. 1950. Einer deutschen Familie ...'
a number cut by the window edge must not become a year: '†bei Shabero, Bezirk Ochwat, Rußland (gefallen) 10. Sept. 1941' once read as 194
the formula is the test, not entry_type: Sokrates is a subject_article (no Werke: block) and Kant is unknown (bespoke bibliography)
Kant, entry_type unknown, is dated from the formula
OMIT a range: 'um 1214 oder 1219' is five years wide
OMIT when there is no dagger: Bourbaki is a collective, not a person
OMIT a dagger inside parentheses: 'Manichäismus, von dem Perser Mani (... 216, †... 276) gegründete Offenbarungsreligion' is an article about a religion
OMIT prose: Antipatros's head is a paragraph ('... Leitung der Stoa. A. hatte viele Schüler ...') whose dagger belongs to Karneades
OMIT a two-digit death year without era marker: Cicero's '106, †... 43' is only dated through MANUAL_LIFEDATES

aggregate_checks.name: coverage of biographies stays high -- 83.4% at the time of writing; a drop means the formula parser regressed, a jump means it started guessing
no dated entry has an impossible life: birth before death, span at most 120 years
